verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents public REST APIs. The Admin SDK Directory API has a reference page for users.list and guides for creating and managing users and devices. The Reports API covers audit and usage reports, and the Cloud Identity API handles identity resources, with Apps Script offered for low-code automation of Admin console tasks. The evidence, however, covers only the admin and identity side, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the guessed paths. Missing for 10: evidence of documented APIs for the core end-user apps (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Calendar), a machine-readable OpenAPI/discovery spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
